changes.support: Fail to inform each buyer orally, at the time he signs the contract or purchases the goods or services, of his right to cancel.

changes.new: Off-premises sales of consumer goods or services of $25 or more, including visits the customer invited (except a visit the customer asked for only to repair or maintain the customer's property), on top of the federal rule
changes.support: an off-premises sale is one where the seller "personally solicits the sale, including those in response to or following an invitation by the buyer"

changes.new: Business day is any day except Sunday and listed holidays including Good Friday, so Saturday counts; refund within 10 business days. Residential roof work after an insurance claim denial has a five business day period with no work or payment until it ends.
changes.support: business day is "Any calendar day except Sunday" or ten listed holidays including Good Friday ((c)(6)), so Saturday counts. Refund within 10 business days.

new.rule: Any contract that automatically renews unless the consumer cancels: disclose the renewal clause clearly and conspicuously in the contract, disclose how to cancel, and for renewals over 60 days send written notice 15 to 45 days before renewal; a violation makes the clause void

changes.support: G.S. 75-41 (automatic renewal) exists and reaches ordinary service contracts; violation makes the clause "void and unenforceable".

Cleaning auto-renewal: first pass said none found. G.S. 75-41 applies to "any products or services to a consumer pursuant to a contract, where the contract automatically renews unless the consumer cancels".
Consumer Goods or Services. - Goods or services purchased, leased, or rented primarily for personal, family, or household purposes

changes.new: No other state's law and no out-of-state forum in a contract to improve NC real property (22B-2, 22B-3)
changes.support: A provision in any contract, subcontract, or purchase order for the improvement of real property in this State, or the providing of materials therefor, is void and against public policy if it makes the contract, subcontract, or purchase order subject to the laws of another state, or provides that the exclusive forum for any litigation, arbitration, or other dispute resolution process is located in another state.

unsure: NC-cancel: the notice applies to any off-premises sale of $25 or more including invited visits, but the builder only knows 'sold at the customer's home'; held anyway because the block is the whole statute section.

NC-cancel-credit: stored on file only, because it applies to consumer credit sales and the builder does not know whether a sale is on credit; the block holds the 25A-40 statement and form together as one notice.

NC-cancel / NC-cancel-form: printed for 'sold at the customer's home'; the statute covers an off-premises sale of $25 or more including invited visits but not a visit the customer asked for only to repair or maintain, which the builder cannot tell.
NC-cancel-credit and NC-cancel-credit-form: the credit-sale statement and form are loaded as two separate notices, both stored on file only.
